snippet.title: Nonplatonic Forms Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the demo here - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3035800/NonPlatonic_Forms/

A theologically spicy visual novel about loving the artistic process a little too literally. Can Lee win his freedom before his captor meta-stasizes deep into his personal narrative?
